cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: What Aren’t You Saying?
cards.instruction: Find out what someone is holding back by treating every careful answer as incomplete.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. These minutes say 'discussion of my proposal.' What did you leave out?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Sign them and we can eat. Nobody wanted an awkward record.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. 'Nobody' sounds crowded. Who wanted my name out of it?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I did. I suggested someone else present, to save your proposal.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Who else? You've recorded my rescue very carefully without naming my replacement.
